5: Initialize a random vector N as the noise for action exploration

8: select action  \( a_{r,t} = \pi(s|\boldsymbol{\theta}) + \mathcal{N}_{t} \) 

9: execute  \( a_{t} \)  and observe the cost  \( C_{t} \)  and state  \( s_{t+1} \)

11: update  \( \omega \leftarrow \omega - \varphi'\eta\nabla_{\omega}\hat{V}(s_{t},\omega) \) 

12: update  \( \theta \leftarrow \theta - \varphi\eta\gamma^{t}\frac{\nabla_{\theta}\pi(a_{t}|s_{t},\boldsymbol{\theta})}{\pi(a_{t}|s_{t},\boldsymbol{\theta})} \) 

13: end for

14: end for

15: return
